# Michael Redman quoted in the Financial Times about enforcement of divorce judgments


- Asset recovery


June 14, 2025


-
-
-
-


Michael Redman , who leads Burford's asset recovery business and London office, speaks with the *Financial Times* about the enforcement of divorce judgments.


Redman discusses how in-depth and painstaking enforcement processes can be: "There are depressingly few eureka moments—it’s all incremental...It’s going jurisdiction by jurisdiction to get legal discovery."


[Read the full article here.](https://www.ft.com/content/32f9ff80-4e25-41f1-9e13-da925317c246)
